text:
All panelists unanimously agree on the figures. The scheduled end-to-end travel time between Orrinford Junction and Tarnside Park is 23 minutes, and trains will run every 6 minutes at peak.

Answer: 23 minutes end-to-end travel time; trains every 6 minutes at peak.

All panelists unanimously agree on both figures. Dredging will deepen the berth pocket to 17.8 metres, and the terminal's annual capacity after the expansion will be 2.1 million TEU.

Answer: The berth pocket will be deepened to 17.8 metres, and the terminal's annual capacity will be 2.1 million TEU after the expansion.

The three-phase expansion programme lays new pipe in three phases: Phase 1 (12.4 km), Phase 2 (8.7 km), and Phase 3 (15.6 km). Summing these gives 12.4 + 8.7 + 15.6 = 36.7 km.

Answer: 36.7 kilometres.

The original public opening date was 14 September 2026. An 11-week delay (77 days) was announced in June 2026. Adding 77 days to the original date yields 30 November 2026.

Answer: 30 November 2026

All panelists unanimously agree on both figures. Mean systolic blood pressure fell by 13.6 mmHg in the tirnapexil arm at week 16, and 19 tirnapexil participants experienced hyperkalaemia.

Answer: Mean systolic blood pressure fell by 13.6 mmHg at week 16, and 19 tirnapexil participants had hyperkalaemia.

All panelists unanimously agree that FVC declined by 171 mL over 52 weeks in the placebo group, and diarrhoea was the most common adverse event, reported in 22% of olvemarin participants.

Answer: FVC declined by 171 mL over 52 weeks in the placebo group, and the most common adverse event was diarrhoea.

All panelists consistently calculated that 54 out of 450 participants in the senotrazide arm discontinued the study drug before day 3, yielding (54 ÷ 450) × 100 = 12%.

Answer: 12%

All panelists agree: 312 participants were randomized to the pelvastrin arm. Of these, 27 withdrew consent, 14 were lost to follow-up, and 19 died before month 24, totaling 60 non-completers. Subtracting these from the total gives 252 completers.

Answer: 252 participants in the pelvastrin arm completed the 24-month follow-up.

All panelists unanimously agree on both figures. Corvane Logistics' order backlog at year end was $386 million, and the company guided fiscal-2026 revenue growth of 6% to 8%.

Answer: $386 million order backlog at year end; 6%–8% revenue growth guidance for fiscal 2026.

All panelists unanimously agree that Ostrel Savings Bank's CET1 ratio at year end was 14.3% and its net interest margin for 2025 was 2.17%.

Answer: CET1 ratio: 14.3%; Net interest margin: 2.17%.

Brightfen Foods' net sales grew from $250 million in fiscal 2024 to $295 million in fiscal 2025, an increase of $45 million. The percentage growth is calculated as (45 / 250) × 100 = 18%.

Answer: 18%

Tamberlin Software defines free cash flow as operating cash flow minus capital expenditures. For fiscal 2025, operating cash flow was $87.3 million and capital expenditures were $52.9 million. Subtracting capital expenditures from operating cash flow yields $34.4 million.

Answer: $34.4 million

The panel unanimously agrees that the jury awarded $1.64 million in compensatory damages and declined to award punitive damages.

Answer: The jury awarded $1.64 million in compensatory damages and did not award punitive damages.

All panelists unanimously agree on the figures. The contractual cap on Solgrave's total liability was 7.5 million euros, and the tribunal awarded Ventrica 6.9 million euros, which fell below the cap.

Answer: The contractual cap was 7.5 million euros; the tribunal awarded Ventrica 6.9 million euros.

All panelists agree that the effective date is 18 February 2025, and the 45-day period begins on 19 February 2025 (day 1). Counting 45 calendar days—10 days in February, 31 in March, and 4 in April—lands on 4 April 2025.

Answer: 4 April 2025.

The defendant has been ordered to pay compensatory damages of $2.35 million, prejudgment interest of $0.41 million, and taxable court costs of $0.12 million, totaling $2.88 million. The 20% contributory negligence reduction is already reflected in the damages, and legal fees are not recoverable.

Answer: $2.88 million.

All panelists unanimously agree that the tephra layer was dated to 4,270 years before present and was found at a depth of 3.8 metres in the core.

Answer: The tephra layer was dated to 4,270 years before present and found at a depth of 3.8 metres in the core.

All panelists unanimously agree that LXP-9 exhibited a room-temperature ionic conductivity of 0.84 mS/cm and that test cells retained 88% of their initial capacity after 500 charge-discharge cycles.

Answer: 0.84 mS/cm ionic conductivity; 88% capacity retention after 500 cycles.

The terminus retreated 384 metres between the 2008 and 2024 surveys, a period of 16 years. Dividing 384 m by 16 years gives an average rate of 24 metres per year.

Answer: 24 metres per year.

The number of breeding pairs fell from 1,480 in 2015 to 1,110 in 2025, a decline of 370 pairs. The percentage decline is (370 ÷ 1,480) × 100 = 25%.

Answer: 25%

All panelists unanimously agree on both figures, supported by evidence E3 and E2.

Answer: 48,600 patients' records were exposed, and the attacker first gained access on 29 July 2025.

All panelists unanimously agree on the figures. An estimated 340 kilograms of ammonia was released before the refrigeration line was isolated, and 3 workers were admitted to hospital overnight.

Answer: Approximately 340 kilograms of ammonia was released, and 3 workers were admitted to hospital overnight.

The outage began at 22:47 UTC on 9 October and ended at 03:12 UTC on 10 October, lasting 4 hours and 25 minutes.

Answer: 4 hours and 25 minutes.

During the 35-minute incident, there were 1,200 checkout attempts per minute, totaling 42,000 attempts. With a 30% failure rate, 12,600 checkout attempts failed.

Answer: 12,600
